rationale.edition: The only changed file is web/src/views/Dashboards/RenderDashboardCharts.vue, which lives under the open-source web/src tree. No enterprise-owned paths (enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, src/enterprise/) appear, and there are no enterprise keywords (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/sensitive-data/logo-management) in the paths or symbols, so this is an OSS change.
rationale.skip: Not skipping: the diff is a real UI code change (not docs/CI/test-data-only), there is no tests-added label or skip request in feature_hint.txt/trigger_comment.txt (both empty), and no explicit opt-out was passed. The change is user-facing, so it proceeds to E2E.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted: the change adds print-mode layout logic (preparePrintLayout/clearPrintLayout, beforeprint/afterprint listeners, print CSS) to dashboard chart rendering. This is a user-exercisable flow — entering print mode and printing/exporting a dashboard should reflow panels without breaking the grid — so it needs Playwright coverage.
rationale.area: Area is Dashboards: the entire change is in web/src/views/Dashboards/RenderDashboardCharts.vue, and sibling specs live under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Dashboards/ (dashboard.spec.js, dashboard2.spec.js, etc.).
rationale.group: Dashboards-Core is the closest matrix shard: it already runs dashboard.spec.js / dashboard2.spec.js / dashboardtype.spec.js and covers the core dashboard rendering/grid behavior that print mode modifies. Dashboards-Charts is chart-viz specific and Dashboards-Settings is settings specific, neither of which fits this rendering change.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. The patch modifies only web/src/views/Dashboards/RenderDashboardCharts.vue (application code), and no files under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/ are changed, so there is no pre-existing Playwright coverage to enhance.
